user_stories.title: Application login
user_stories.i_want: Registered user will log into the application and based on the login name the user will be recognized either as a student or a teacher

rules.text: student: intends to log into the application
teacher: intends to log into the application
Users' account already exists - not possible to sign in a new account
Information regarding all registered users can be displayed by clicking on the Database Contents reference from the UIS homepage
If another user needs to be added to the UIS it has to be done by importing data file into the DB (option Export/Import DB on the upper bar)

acceptance_criteria.title: Preconditions
statements: User is on the UIS homepage
No other user is logged in - the upper bar has a black colour and on the right side there is a visible Login option of the menu

acceptance_criteria.title: Trigger
statements: User selects the Login option from the menu located on the right side of the upper bar

acceptance_criteria.title: Main success scenario
statements: User will select the Login option from the menu located on the right side of the upper bar
Specific Login Page form will appear
User will fill his/her login name that already exists (=is registered in the UIS)
User will enter `pass` in the password field - the universal password for all users
User will press the Login button
UIS determines whether the user is either a student or a teacher by checking the users' login name
Login option disappears from the top bar menu
Clickable first and last name of the logged-in user appear in the upper bar on the right
Logout option appears in the upper bar on the right
User with student's status sees a Student's view menu, the upper bar is orange
User with teacher's status sees a Teacher's view menu, the upper bar is dark green
Overview page appears to both Student and Teacher

acceptance_criteria.title: Alternative alt-1
statements: **5a. Selected login name does not exist in the UIS**
Postconditions:
User is not redirected from the Login Page
Error message regarding an unsuccessful login attempt appears
**5b. User enters other password than a `pass`**
Postconditions:
User is not redirected from the Login Page
Error message regarding an unsuccessful login attempt appears

One subject can be taught by up to two teachers and each one of them can announce up to 3 exam dates. Teacher can only evaluate students registered on the exam date announced by him/her.
After selecting the item from the menu Set Evaluation the entry form has predefined entries
One of the taught subject (selected randomly) will appear with a exam date
The first of the participans is selected (in order of the date of registration on exam date)
Score A is selected

acceptance_criteria.title: Preconditions
statements: Teacher is already logged in to the UIS
Teacher is on the page Set Evaluation

acceptance_criteria.title: Trigger
statements: Teacher enters values and entries to the form

acceptance_criteria.title: Main success scenario
statements: Teacher selects the desired subject and exam date from the menu
Teacher selects the desired student from the dropdown menu
Teacher selects the desired evaluation from the dropdown menu
Teacher clicks on the button Save evaluation
UIS will enter the student's result for the selected subject
Message confirming a successful execution will appear
UIS adds the results to the student for the selected subject and edits its DB and its tables accordingly
Teacher is still on page Set Evaluation
Message confirming a successful execution appears
Appropriate subject and the exam date remain selected in the dropdown menu
The student disappears from the list in the dropdown menu
Evaluation A is predefined in the dropdown menu
If the student scored A-E (i.e. he/she passed), he/she is removed from the list in the menu My Subjects
If the student scored F (i.e. he/she did not pass), he/she remains on the list in the menu My Subjects
The student disappears from the list of examination participans in the menu My Exam Dates
The evaluation will appear by the student in the menu Evaluation Table with the filter Includes students with already set grade turned on
Student's View: regardless on the evaluation, the subject disappears from the table in the menu My Exam Dates
Student's View: if the student scored A-E (i.e. he/she passed), the subject is removed from the table Enrolled Subjects in he menu My Subjects
Student's View: if the student scored A-E (i.e. he/she passed), credits are added to the amount in the header of the table Completed Subjects in the menu My Subjects
Student's View: if the student scored A-E (i.e. he/she passed), the subject appears with the achieved score in the table Completed Subjects in the menu My Subjects
Student's View: if the student scored A-E (i.e. he/she passed), the subject disappears from the table in the menu Other Exam Dates
Student's View: if the student scored F (i.e. he/she did not pass), the subject remains in the table Enrolled Subjects in the menu My Subjects
Student's View: if the student scored F (i.e. he/she did not pass), the subject remains in the table in the menu Other Exam Dates
